Policy Name: Cigna Lumbar Fusion (CMM-609: Lumbar Fusion with Decompression)

Required findings: Deformity must be non‑fixed and require 5°‑10° of correction per spinal segment (Smith‑Peterson or Ponte osteotomy).

Radiographic evidence of either a lumbar sagittal plane deformity with sagittal vertical axis (SVA) > 8 cm or pelvic incidence‑lumbar lordosis (PI‑LL) mismatch > 15°, OR a coronal deformity with limited flexibility and Cobb angle > 30°.
Maximum of four (4) posterior column osteotomies performed at the apex of the deformity per correction surgery, unless the diagnosis is Scheuermann's kyphosis (no limit).

Procedure must be performed in conjunction with a fusion and must meet the criteria outlined in the applicable procedure‑specific sections (e.g., CMM‑609.4 Lumbar Fusion with Decompression, CMM‑609.5 Lumbar Fusion without Decompression, etc.).

Deformity must be fixed and require >30° of correction in the sagittal plane for a pedicle subtraction osteotomy (PSO), OR a large fixed coronal deformity >60° that is amenable to an asymmetric osteotomy.
Procedure must be performed in conjunction with a fusion and must meet the criteria outlined in the applicable procedure‑specific sections.

Non-Indications: Fixed sagittal deformities requiring ≤30° of correction (does not meet three‑column osteotomy threshold).
Non‑fixed deformities requiring >10° correction per segment (exceeds posterior column osteotomy correction range).
More than four posterior column osteotomies performed for a non‑Scheuermann’s kyphosis deformity.
Absence of required radiographic measurements (SVA, PI‑LL, Cobb angle) to demonstrate the specified deformity severity.
Procedures performed without an accompanying fusion.
Failure to satisfy the criteria in the referenced procedure‑specific sections (e.g., lumbar fusion with or without decompression).
Important criteria & exceptions: Maximum of four posterior column osteotomies per correction surgery, except for Scheuermann's kyphosis where no limit applies.
All osteotomies must be performed in addition to a fusion procedure.
Criteria must also be met in the applicable procedure‑specific sections (e.g., pediatric spinal deformity, lumbar fusion with/without decompression, adjacent segment disease, etc.).
Documentation required: Standing full‑length lateral spine radiograph with measurement of sagittal vertical axis (SVA).
Standing full‑length lateral spine radiograph with measurement of pelvic incidence‑lumbar lordosis (PI‑LL) mismatch.
Standing full‑length anteroposterior (AP) spine radiograph with Cobb angle measurement for coronal deformity.
Radiology report documenting the above measurements and indicating deformity flexibility (if assessed).
Operative report specifying the type of osteotomy (PCO vs. PSO/VCR), number of levels osteotomized, and confirmation that fusion will be performed.
Diagnosis documentation confirming Scheuermann's kyphosis when exceeding four PCOs.
Relevant prior surgical reports if the case involves repeat fusion or adjacent segment disease.
